scope_rationale: One conservative common ordinary operating point within previously exercised per-platform rate ranges; not maximum capacity, a device/payload sweep or an N-scaling experiment. D39/S5 supplies 300 s warm-up, 600 s confirmation and at least five repetitions. Each repetition has unique run/devices and distinct time window; shared deployed/database state is retained and disclosed, not claimed to be cold-start IID replications.
replicate_reporting: Report per-run nearest-rank p99 and conditional receipt denominator, then min/median/max and empirical replicate variation across the five runs. Do not pool messages as independent replications or claim five successes prove a reliability probability. Invalid attempts and valid platform failures remain in the executed matrix; no favorable early stopping or automatic replacement.

not_in_this_batch.reason: Do not repeat merely for completeness; existing evidence retained with original endpoint. Fresh runs only if required by a separately selected comparison.
No new scaling or capacity claim sought in the narrowed ordinary batch.

not_in_this_batch.case: configurations exceeding rendered fixed memory/cpuset budgets
not_in_this_batch.reason: Do not infer infeasibility solely from absence of a test.
